description: This file defines the TimeDate class, a core component for managing date and time operations within the SuiteCRM (a fork and extension of SugarCRM). It provides methods for formatting, parsing, converting, and retrieving date/time objects in different formats and timezones, including user preferences and system defaults. The class supports handling date ranges, timezone conversions, and date validation, integrating with user settings and global configurations.

classes.name: TimeDate
classes.description: Main class providing comprehensive date and time handling functionalities, including formatting, parsing, timezone adjustments, and date range computations. It manages user preferences, caching, and system defaults to facilitate date/time operations across the application.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Singleton pattern getter for TimeDate class instance, initializing with PHP timezone settings if necessary.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Sets the current user context for date/time preferences and timezone calculations.

methods.name: get_date_format
methods.description: Retrieves the preferred date format for the given user or system default.

methods.name: get_time_format
methods.description: Retrieves the preferred time format for the given user or system default.

methods.name: get_date_time_format
methods.description: Gets the combined date and time format string for the user, with caching.

methods.name: asDb
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object into the standard database datetime string.

methods.name: fromDb
methods.description: Creates a SugarDateTime object from a database-formatted datetime string.

methods.name: fromUser
methods.description: Creates a SugarDateTime object from a user-formatted datetime string, considering user timezone.

methods.name: to_display_date
methods.description: Converts a database-stored datetime to a user-display format, with optional timezone adjustment.

methods.name: to_display_time
methods.description: Converts a database-stored time to user display format.

methods.name: to_db
methods.description: Converts a user local datetime string into a GMT-based database datetime string, including timezone conversion.

methods.name: now
methods.description: Returns current user datetime in user format.

methods.name: userTimezone
methods.description: Static method that returns the name of the timezone for a specific user or current user.
